starts without this one's messages.

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,glob,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

# Compare f output vs expected on demos and list mismatches to diagnose.
def f(I):
    H=len(I);W=len(I[0]);bg=I[0][0]; O=[r[:] for r in I]
    pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]!=bg]
    minR=min(p[0] for p in pts); maxR=max(p[0] for p in pts); minC=min(p[1] for p in pts); maxC=max(p[1] for p in pts)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]!=bg: continue
            hfill = (L:=None)  # placeholder, will compute below
            break
        # horizontal single gap: left neighbor not bg, right neighbor not bg
            if c-1>=0 and c+1<W and I[r][c-1]!=bg and I[r][c+1]!=bg:
                O[r][c]=2
            elif (r-1>=0 and r+1<H and I[r-1][c]!=bg and I[r+1][c]!=bg
                 and (r==minR or r==maxR or c==minC or c==maxC)):
                O[r][c]=2
    return O
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    I=G[k+' input']; O=G[k+' output']
    out=f(I)
    bad=[(i,j,O[i][j],out[i][j]) for i in range(len(I)) for j in range(len(I[0])) if O[i][j]!=out[i][j]]
    print(k,'mismatches',bad[:15])

# Gather changed cells across all demos and tabulate features
data={}
for i in range(1,9):
    si=G[f'Demo pair {i} input']; so=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    h,w=len(si),len(si[0])
    bg=Counter(v for r in si for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    fg=set(v for r in si for v in r if v!=bg)
    ch=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if si[r][c]!=so[r][c]]
    data[i]=(si,so,bg,fg,ch)
for i,(si,so,bg,fg,ch) in data.items():
    h,w=len(si),len(si[0])
    # for each changed bg cell: min distance (manhattan) to nearest fg cell, and whether aligned
    stats=[]
    for r,c in ch:
        if si[r][c]==bg:
            # aligned horizontally or vertically with an fg cell
            horiz=any(si[r][cc]==next(iter(fg)) for cc in range(c+1,w) if si[r][cc]!=bg) or any(si[r][cc]!=bg for cc in range(c))
            vert=any(si[rr][c]!=bg for rr in range(r+1,h) if si[rr][c]!=bg) or any(si[rr][c]!=bg for rr in range(r))
            stats.append(('H','V') if horiz and vert else ('h-only' if horiz else ('v-only' if vert else 'none')))
    print(i, Counter(stats))

def feats(g,r,c):

    def dist(line,bgval):
        k=1
        while True:
            if k>=h or k>=w: return None
            a=r+k if line==0 else c+k
            b=r-k if line==0 else c-k
            if not(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w) or g[a][b]==bgval: return None
            if g[a][b]!=bgval: return k
            k+=1
    L=dist(0,None) if False else None
    # proper: horizontal: scan left/right along row r; vertical: scan up/down along col c
    dl=None;dr=None
    k=1
    while c-k>=0 and g[r][c-k]!=5: dl=k;k+=1
    k=1
    while c+k<w and g[r][c+k]!=5: dr=k;k+=1
    du=None;dd=None

    while r-k>=0 and g[r-k][c]!=5: du=k;k+=1
    k=1

def f(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0]); bg=I[0][0]
    # find marker color and frame bbox
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in I for x in r if x!=bg)
    mc=max(cnt,key=cnt.get)
    rows=[i for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==mc]
    cols=[j for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j]==mc]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols)
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    for j in range(c0,c1+1):
        for i in (r0,r1):
            if O[i][j]==bg: O[i][j]=2
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in (c0,c1):
            if O[i][j]==bg: O[i][j]=2
    return O
